name: popsicle
headline: SplashMarketingAI: Marketing Automation Platform
short_description: A complete, production-ready SaaS marketing automation platform built with PHP and MySQL. Similar to MailChimp, Klaviyo, and HubSpot Marketing, featuring contacts management, email/SMS/social campaigns, automation flows, AI content generation, and comprehensive analytics.
author: ahmedsaadawi13

sections.overview:
SplashMarketingAI is a complete, production-ready marketing automation platform comparable to MailChimp, Klaviyo, and HubSpot Marketing. It enables teams to manage unlimited contacts, create email/SMS/social campaigns, build visual automation workflows, and generate AI-powered content. The platform includes dynamic segmentation, real-time analytics with open and click tracking, multi-tenant SaaS architecture with role-based access control, and a REST API for programmatic integration. Built on PHP 7.0+ and MySQL 5.7+, it's designed for agencies and businesses needing complete marketing automation without external dependencies.
Managing subscriber lists and creating dynamic segments based on engagement and custom attributes
Automating welcome series and triggered email campaigns with visual workflow builder
Sending coordinated email, SMS, and social media broadcasts to segmented audiences
Generating AI-powered email and SMS copy with template library support
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/ahmedsaadawi13/splash-marketing-ai`
sections.usage:
```
Create a 30-day email drip campaign for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business, to nurture leads and convert them into customers. The campaign should include 5 emails with the following goals: [GOAL1], [GOAL2], [GOAL3], [GOAL4], [GOAL5]. Use [DATA] to personalize the content and include AI-generated subject lines and content for each email.
```
Copy

